sequence: Fixed after hotspot-based candidates existed, before retrieval or inspection of optical scene outcomes. Agent review is not blinded.
comparison_rule: For each candidate in published rank order, select nearest unused 0.25-degree cell with September 2003-2017 Aqua median >=5 and both September 2019 Aqua and adjusted NPP <= median. Tie: longitude, latitude. Same Kalimantan rectangle. These are lower-activity comparison cells, NOT fire-free controls.
optical_source: Landsat 8 Collection 2 Level 2 USGS reflectance, public Planetary Computer STAC mirror. Separate instrument from MODIS/VIIRS.
scene_rule: For each cell select before scene during 2019-08-01 to 2019-08-31 and during scene during 2019-09-01 to 2019-09-30. Require scene footprint >=95% cell. Prefer lowest scene cloud_cover, tie by proximity to 15th of month then item id. Retain missing, cloudy, ambiguous cases. No replacement based on visual outcome.
review: Agent visual review of georeferenced SWIR2/NIR/red composites and valid-pixel NBR change, explicitly non-blinded and exploratory. Corroborated means visible fire-related evidence supports burning in this cell during/around September; contradicted requires specific positive competing interpretation, NOT simple absence of visible fire; otherwise inconclusive. Burn scars do not establish active-fire timing or validate hotspot totals.
qa: Mask fill, dilated cloud, cirrus, cloud, cloud shadow and snow using QA_PIXEL; mask radiometric saturation. Report paired clear valid fraction; no result if <20%. Threshold is an engineering gate, not validation.
outputs: Publish selected cell bounds, dates, scene IDs and source URLs, band/QA transformations, thumbnails and numeric diagnostics, all six outcomes and limitations. No user or practitioner validation.
processing_note: 900x900 EPSG:4326 subsets, nearest-neighbour reprojection of 30 m inputs; reflectance scale 0.0000275 and offset -0.2. Exclude out-of-range reflectance from NBR diagnostics. Display composites preserve cloud/haze. NBR >0.1 decrease fraction is descriptive, not a fire classifier.
post_inspection_amendment: After initial visual inspection exposed water in comparison 3, add an explicitly separate land-only median excluding QA_PIXEL water bit in either date; retain original all-valid diagnostics. No cell, scene, gate or classification rule was changed.
